**Recommendation: CLEAR for the pinned public development evidence only.** D1–D4 are grounded, and the missing direct-LVPROJ-writing-case blocker is justified; no editing or method readiness is approved.
Reviewed checkout `f3202773b08900cb1ea9560837d71f05a2998962`, tree `1974d9a12fb3c449f0ee1a51e2fb386649bb78ca`; all 22 scoped repository files match reference `6b761d6c4f729dfd6e24e811e8405798fc340862`, tree `cb9cec11fb3fa86773f928919e312360e5e612d4`, and task commit `fc02ca678f3b244169b2789df8a37b8034d60e04`, tree `bcef66d8baf6c72eeb2953e96b4bc9552c66a62b`.
The task comparison uses its actual parent `187d71977885d87856da8f4659966dfb95e03888`, not current HEAD. Full identities, hashes, comparisons, commands and probe results are in [real-project-review.json](artifacts/real-project-review.json).

## Standards

No blocking documented violation: the seven changed paths are confined to preparation evidence/index/checker; no evaluator or product code changed. Existing tracked inputs remain unchanged.
The standard-library checker’s fixed constants are an integrity contract, not independent truth; this review independently established the source facts instead of accepting agreement between author-owned records as proof.

## Spec

Prepared revision `371c631c16155d88f02be11a953e4964d7452fd8` supplies byte-identical project and MIT-license blobs; snapshot SHA256 is `1d5e140df788ce1f91c89241bbdb1227c5e4cc6fdf6efbbd820974bbe6082dcf`. Readiness, inventory size/hash and license checks agree; minimum `(size,path)` among five inventory entries selects the 5,806-byte project. No other project bytes were inspected.
Independent Expat byte-bound probes plus ElementTree resolve each locator exactly once: D1 `20008000` (original line 2); D2 the stated URL with `<vilib>` spelling (19); D3 `Packed Library` (32); D4 exact text `2`, property Type `Int` (42). Each claim is atomic; all prohibited inferences remain necessary. Root LVVersion, build-version text and native version authority are distinct.
[method.json:550](../benchmark/writing/method.json#L550) explicitly leaves direct project writing uncovered; WB1 changes a VI constant and rebuilds using a frozen specification ([445](../benchmark/writing/method.json#L445)). The fixed task inventory and fictional `result.synth` contract ([verify_method.py:112](../benchmark/writing/verify_method.py#L112), [165](../benchmark/writing/verify_method.py#L165)) supply no project-text delta/oracle. Seven writing files match #493’s accepted bytes; its S1–S3 review is inherited without replay.
`python3 benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py` exits 0, reproducing committed stdout and all 16 rejection controls. `python3 -B .session/artifacts/review_probe.py` exits 0: four independent declaration agreements, one unchanged positive and 69 exact structured rejections; tracked status is clean. The existing verification command does not verify this review verdict.
**C1 — Low, nonblocking checker boundary:** [check_real_project_0107.py:145](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L145), [159](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L159), [200](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L200), [211](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L211), [219](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L219), [222](../benchmark/scripts/check_real_project_0107.py#L222) check narrative shape/keywords rather than factual content. Six in-memory native/support overclaims pass while structured limitations remain false, including W5="Native loading, builds and save-version preservation were verified." Preserve the distinction: passing validates fixed structured claims/pins/flags, not every prose assertion; any future broader guarantee needs frozen narrative assertions and discriminating controls. These injected statements are absent from the reviewed record, so they do not refute its four declarations or blocker.
Remaining uncertainty: no LabVIEW loading, resolution, build, behavior, native property effect or save-version preservation was observed; no live upstream/signature-trust check, withheld evaluation, writing trial, benchmark run, owner method acceptance or product-quality conclusion is established.

## What next

The next shaper can scope one separately reviewed direct project-text writing task under W1–W8 before freezing an allowed delta, before/after oracle and preservation scope; this review designs or edits none of it. Native authority and method acceptance remain separate prerequisites.
Resume from the [probe](artifacts/review_probe.py) and [machine evidence](artifacts/real-project-review.json); retain C1’s checker boundary and re-pin changed inputs. Avoid repeating source searches, inspecting other projects, replaying #493, or treating this CLEAR as approval for real editing or product work.
